title: Jason Sands: they want their stuff back

tellings.quote: they want their stuff back and they're going to kill everybody involved in the program if they don't get it.

plain: Whoever owns the material held in a secret program wants it returned, and they are "going to kill everybody involved in the program if they don't get it", according to a man named Jason Sands. Michels repeats this second-hand, saying Sands said it on the show of the interviewer Joe Rogan. Taken at face value, it would mean the program is holding something its owners want back and are willing to fight for.
